lines.en: Moving like a shadow through the night
Whisper of darkness at your ear
Every step in the shadow's embrace
Night's low whisper in the dark
I stalk across the shards of a dream.
A silhouette surfaces from the shadows.
A black shadow in the night
Peering at the shadows behind you
Peering into the darkness around you

lines.zh: 梦魇里，我的影子比蜡烛多。
lines.en: In the nightmare, my shadows outnumber the candles.

lines.zh: 你身上的光芒让我不安。
lines.en: The light on you unsettles me.

lines.zh: 你的存在是对我的嘲讽。

lines.en: In the nightmare, pearls come out dirty.
I am the messenger of the night.
Secrets of the shadows are mine.

lines.zh: 我的黑暗比你想象的深。
lines.en: My darkness is deeper than you think.
Do not let light taint me.

lines.zh: 我们的力量将融为一体。
你的攻击只会加速我的。
你撞碎的只是我的影子。
我的阴影吞噬你的力量。
我们的碰撞将产生力量。
你的力量在我面前微不足道。

lines.en: Let us meet in the darkness.
Let us merge in the shadows.
Coexist with me, and darkness will fade.

lines.zh: 我们的结合将创造新生命。
lines.en: Our union will create new life.

lines.zh: 两团黑影合在一起，更浓了。
lines.en: Two patches of black merge into something deeper.
Be with me, and you will not be alone.

lines.zh: 我们的结合将带来力量。
在梦魇中找到真正的伴侣。
lines.en: Find your true partner in the nightmare.

lines.zh: 在你附近漂浮，发出微弱的绿光。
lines.en: Flickers weak green light near you.

lines.zh: 接近时发出咯咯声，然后消失不见。
lines.en: Giggles when you approach, then vanishes.

lines.zh: 附在你身上，感受你的恐惧。
lines.en: Attaches to you, feeling your fear.

lines.zh: 咕哝着消失，留下肮脏的珍珠。
lines.en: Gurgles and vanishes, leaving a dirty pearl.

lines.zh: 缓缓靠近，低吟着进入你的梦中。
lines.en: Creeps closer, murmuring into your dreams.

lines.zh: 从黑暗中升起，发出嘶嘶声。
靠近时低语，讲述梦魇的故事。
lines.en: Whispers when you approach, telling nightmare tales.

lines.zh: 咕噜着靠近，似乎在寻找什么。
lines.en: Grunts as it approaches, searching for something.

lines.zh: 附在你身上，吸取你的梦想。
lines.en: Attach to you, siphoning your dreams.

lines.zh: 在你身上徘徊，直到你醒来。
lines.en: Hovers on you until you wake.

lines.zh: 感知到猎物，发出低沉的吼声。
lines.en: Lowers a deep growl upon sensing prey.

lines.zh: 盯着你，似乎在等待最佳时机。
lines.en: Stares at you, waiting for the right moment.

lines.zh: 靠近你时低语，意图已定。
lines.en: Whispers as it approaches, intent clear.

lines.zh: 在你附近发出呢喃声，等待最佳时机。
lines.en: Murmurs near you, waiting for the perfect moment.

lines.zh: 感知到你的存在，低声咆哮。
lines.en: Whispers a low roar, sensing your presence.

lines.zh: 盯着你，直到你动弹不得。
lines.en: Stares at you until you can’t move.

lines.zh: 靠近你时低吟，准备攻击。
lines.en: Whispers as it nears, preparing to attack.

lines.zh: 感知到你，低语着锁定目标。
lines.en: Whispers as it senses you, locking onto you.

lines.zh: 活人的心跳，在梦魇里太响。
lines.en: A living heartbeat is too loud in a nightmare.
You have stepped into my dark.
I hear you turn in your sleep.

lines.zh: 梦里的猎物，一个都跑不掉。
嘶嘶着靠近你，准备撕裂你的梦境。
lines.en: Hisses as it approaches, ready to rip your dreams.
Rumbles a low growl, ready to attack.

lines.zh: 发出嘶嘶声，靠近并准备攻击。
lines.en: Hisses, approaching and readying an attack.

lines.zh: 低声咆哮，靠近并锁定目标。
lines.en: Whispers a low roar, approaching and locking on.

lines.zh: 靠近你，发出咯咯声，准备撕咬。
lines.en: Giggles as it nears, preparing to bite.

lines.zh: 低吟着接近，准备撕咬你的梦想。
lines.en: Whispers as it approaches, preparing to bite your dreams.

lines.zh: 低吼着接近，准备撕裂你的梦境。
lines.en: Rumbles a low growl, approaching to rip your dreams.

lines.zh: 靠近并发出咯咯声，准备攻击。
lines.en: Giggles as it nears, preparing to attack.

lines.zh: 嘶嘶着靠近，准备撕咬你的身体。
lines.en: Hisses as it approaches, ready to bite your body.

lines.zh: 我只有十点血，可我不怕。
lines.en: Only ten points of health, but I'm not afraid.

lines.zh: 呼吸慢下来，你动不了了。
lines.en: Your breathing slows; you cannot move.
I slip into your dream and wait.
The dark closes in from every side.

lines.zh: 你的名字在梦魇里被念出。
lines.en: Your name is spoken in the nightmare.

lines.zh: 我数到三，你就醒不过来。
lines.en: I count to three, and you do not wake.
Don't look back. I am right behind.
The light is yours; the dark is mine.
This layer of dream belongs to me now.

lines.zh: 你越挣扎，影子缠得越紧。
lines.en: The more you struggle, the tighter the shadow.

lines.zh: 我从你脚边的影子里长出爪子。
lines.en: Claws grow out of the shadow at your feet.
A black claw rakes your back.

lines.zh: 我把你的恐惧捏成利刃。
lines.en: I shape your fear into a blade.
A hand reaches up from beneath your feet.
The dark crawls into your wound.
A shadow blade grazes your throat.
I become a monster in your eyes.
A whisper bursts beside your ear.
Your own shadow knocks you down.
From the depths of dreams, shadows emerge!

lines.zh: 梦魇裂开一道缝，我挤出来。
lines.en: A seam opens in the nightmare, and I squeeze out.

lines.zh: 灯灭的瞬间，我站在这里。
lines.en: The instant the light dies, I am standing here.

lines.zh: 火光刺眼，我的影子退开了。
lines.en: The firelight stings; my shadow pulls back.
The blast tears open my curtain of shadow.

lines.zh: 符文的亮光灼穿了我的黑雾。
lines.en: Rune light burns through my black mist.

lines.zh: 雷光一亮，影子被钉在地上。
lines.en: One flash of lightning pins my shadow to the ground.
